cases.name: blake3-mac-generate-1024
cases.notes: Same workload and timed operation as cases/blake3-keyed-1024/native/main.mo. Expected tag is the first 32 bytes of the official 1024-byte keyed vector.

cases.name: blake3-mac-verify-1024-valid
cases.notes: Recompute keyedHash and compare all 32 tag bytes with XOR/OR; no mismatch-dependent early exit. Input/tag setup and correctness assertions run outside measurement.
